profile_text.body:
Pinecone is a New York-based technology company founded in 2019 that provides a fully managed vector database built for AI applications. The company describes its product as enabling search through billions of items for similar matches to any object in milliseconds, positioning it as a next-generation search solution accessible via API call.

The core Pinecone product sits in the coding and developer tools category and is designed to support retrieval-augmented generation infrastructure, with writes that are instantly searchable, automatic indexing, and queries that remain fast at scale. The company also offers data residency options and enterprise security features. The site's held facts indicate a New York law exposure count of 311 associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are on record.
